class.name: RelayListItem
class.brief_description: A single position of the automatic starting sequence table (RList), used by electric vehicles with resistor-based starting.
class.description: Each [RelayListItem] corresponds to one line of the [code]RList[/code] table. Its index within [member TrainElectricSeriesEngine.relay_list] corresponds to the controller position, starting from 1 (position 0 is not part of the list).

members.member: [code]RList:E[/code] Whether this position is engaged automatically (true) or only manually (false).
[code]RList:C[/code] Number of parallel motor branches at this position.
[code]RList:D[/code] Number of motors per branch at this position.
[code]RList:A[/code] Target starting-sequence position associated with this entry.
[code]RList:B[/code] Starting resistance at this position, in ohms.
[code]RList:F[/code] If the controller has field shunting, which shunt stage applies at this position.
